fullText.simplified:
二十二、水淹金山寺

    金山寺离杭州不远，是当地有名的大寺。寺里有很多和尚，他们都是法海的弟子，但法海不教他们法术，他只想教许仙一个人。在法海心里，许仙是最有可能通过修行成为神仙的人，所以他只把许仙一个人当成真正的弟子。
    许仙来到金山寺，再也没了出去的机会。他和法海住在一个房间，法海每天教他修行。但许仙的心里空空的，他什么都不想学。他一会儿想白素贞，一会儿想空中的那条白蛇。白素贞是蛇妖的事情，现在他已经接受了——不管她是什么，我都爱她，她是我孩子的母亲，是我最爱的人。
    一个月过去了，许仙越来越想白素贞。
    这天，法海正带着许仙修行，寺外一声大响传了进来。
    “法海，快把我相公放了！”
    那是白素贞的声音。
    许仙第一个冲出去，他见到了飞在空中的白素贞和小青。他的眼泪马上掉下来了。
    “相公！”白素贞也看到了他。
    许仙跑向白素贞，但身后一片金光把他拉了回去。
    这片金光是法海的。“大胆蛇妖！敢来我金山寺！”法海生气叫道。
    白素贞看向法海，眼里火光闪动：“法海，虽然我是妖，但我从没做过坏事。你虽然是和尚，却做着让我和相公分离的事。谁是坏人，谁是好人，我相信会有人知道的！今天，如果你不放了我相公，我一定让你再也看不到金山寺！”
    “好大的口气！”法海高高抬起钵盂，钵盂发出强光，全部向白素贞照去。
    小青变作青色的闪电，向法海劈去，但法海身上有一层金光把他保护住了，小青的闪电劈不进去。白素贞开始用法术，风起云来，天地变色！雨点落下来。大雨中，天地一片黑色。慢慢地，黑色的天空里出现了一片海，海水正向金山寺冲来！
    “海！大海！天上怎么有海！”
    “快跑啊！大水来了！”
    金山寺里的和尚们大叫着跑了。
    法海把钵盂转向天空，那片海被照亮了。海水飞速地冲来，又急又快！
    法海又惊又急：“这只蛇妖怎么会有这么强的法力？”
    许仙站在法海身后，他吃惊地看着空中的海水，脸因为害怕而变白了。他被吓到了，过了好一会儿才明白过来，他对着白素贞的方向大叫：“不要这么做！快把这些水收回去！”虽然他已经用了最大的声音，但还是太小了，天上的白素贞一点儿都听不到。
    “走！”法海拉着许仙，向金山寺外飞去。
    天空倒下来，海水冲下来，金山寺马上就被海水淹没了。海水流向城里，许多房子也被淹没了。
fullText.traditional:
二十二、水淹金山寺

    金山寺離杭州不遠，是當地有名的大寺。寺裡有很多和尚，他們都是法海的弟子，但法海不教他們法術，他只想教許仙一個人。在法海心裡，許仙是最有可能通過修行成為神仙的人，所以他只把許仙一個人當成真正的弟子。
    許仙來到金山寺，再也沒了出去的機會。他和法海住在一個房間，法海每天教他修行。但許仙的心裡空空的，他什麼都不想學。他一會兒想白素貞，一會兒想空中的那條白蛇。白素貞是蛇妖的事情，現在他已經接受了——不管她是什麼，我都愛她，她是我孩子的母親，是我最愛的人。
    一個月過去了，許仙越來越想白素貞。
    這天，法海正帶著許仙修行，寺外一聲大響傳了進來。
    “法海，快把我相公放了！”
    那是白素貞的聲音。
    許仙第一個衝出去，他見到了飛在空中的白素貞和小青。他的眼淚馬上掉下來了。
    “相公！”白素貞也看到了他。
    許仙跑向白素貞，但身後一片金光把他拉了回去。
    這片金光是法海的。“大膽蛇妖！敢來我金山寺！”法海生氣叫道。
    白素貞看向法海，眼裡火光閃動：“法海，雖然我是妖，但我從沒做過壞事。你雖然是和尚，卻做著讓我和相公分離的事。誰是壞人，誰是好人，我相信會有人知道的！今天，如果你不放了我相公，我一定讓你再也看不到金山寺！”
    “好大的口氣！”法海高高抬起缽盂，缽盂發出強光，全部向白素貞照去。
    小青變作青色的閃電，向法海劈去，但法海身上有一層金光把他保護住了，小青的閃電劈不進去。白素貞開始用法術，風起雲來，天地變色！雨點落下來。大雨中，天地一片黑色。慢慢地，黑色的天空裡出現了一片海，海水正向金山寺衝來！
    “海！大海！天上怎麼有海！”
    “快跑啊！大水來了！”
    金山寺裡的和尚們大叫著跑了。
    法海把缽盂轉向天空，那片海被照亮了。海水飛速地衝來，又急又快！
    法海又驚又急：“這隻蛇妖怎麼會有這麼強的法力？”
    許仙站在法海身後，他吃驚地看著空中的海水，臉因為害怕而變白了。他被嚇到了，過了好一會兒才明白過來，他對著白素貞的方向大叫：“不要這麼做！快把這些水收回去！”雖然他已經用了最大的聲音，但還是太小了，天上的白素貞一點兒都聽不到。
    “走！”法海拉著許仙，向金山寺外飛去。
    天空倒下來，海水衝下來，金山寺馬上就被海水淹沒了。海水流向城裡，許多房子也被淹沒了。

sentences.english: Fahai was both shocked and anxious: “How does this snake demon have such strong magical powers?”

sentences.traditional: 許仙站在法海身後，他吃驚地看著空中的海水，臉因為害怕而變白了。
sentences.pinyin: xǔ xiān zhàn zài fǎ hǎi shēn hòu tā chī jīng de kàn zhe kōng zhōng de hǎi shuǐ liǎn yīn wèi hài pà ér biàn bái le
sentences.english: Xu Xian stood behind Fahai. He looked at the seawater in the sky in shock, his face turning pale with fear.

sentences.simplified: 他被吓到了，过了好一会儿才明白过来，
sentences.traditional: 他被嚇到了，過了好一會兒才明白過來，
sentences.pinyin: tā bèi xià dào le guò le hǎo yí huì'r cái míng bai guò lái
sentences.english: He was frightened, and it took him a while to understand.

sentences.simplified: 他对着白素贞的方向大叫：“不要这么做！快把这些水收回去！”
sentences.traditional: 他對著白素貞的方向大叫：“不要這麼做！快把這些水收回去！”
sentences.pinyin: tā duì zhe bái sù zhēn de fāng xiàng dà jiào bú yào zhè me zuò kuài bǎ zhè xiē shuǐ shōu huí qu
sentences.english: He shouted in the direction of Bai Suzhen, “Don’t do this! Quick, take this water back!”

sentences.simplified: 虽然他已经用了最大的声音，但还是太小了，
sentences.traditional: 雖然他已經用了最大的聲音，但還是太小了，
sentences.pinyin: suī rán tā yǐ jīng yòng le zuì dà de shēng yīn dàn hái shi tài xiǎo le
sentences.english: Even though he was speaking in his loudest voice, it was still too quiet.

sentences.simplified: 天上的白素贞一点儿都听不到。
sentences.traditional: 天上的白素貞一點兒都聽不到。
sentences.pinyin: tiān shàng de bái sù zhēn yì diǎn'r dōu tīng bú dào
sentences.english: Bai Suzhen in the sky could not hear anything at all.

sentences.simplified: “走！”法海拉着许仙，向金山寺外飞去。
sentences.traditional: “走！”法海拉著許仙，向金山寺外飛去。
sentences.pinyin: zǒu fǎ hǎi lā zhe xǔ xiān xiàng jīn shān sì wài fēi qù
sentences.english: “Go!” Fahai grabbed Xu Xian and flew out of Jinshan Temple.

sentences.simplified: 天空倒下来，海水冲下来，金山寺马上就被海水淹没了。
sentences.traditional: 天空倒下來，海水衝下來，金山寺馬上就被海水淹沒了。
sentences.pinyin: tiān kōng dǎo xià lái hǎi shuǐ chōng xià lái jīn shān sì mǎ shàng jiù bèi hǎi shuǐ yān mò le
sentences.english: The sky collapsed, and the seawater rushed in. Jinshan Temple was immediately flooded by the seawater.

sentences.simplified: 海水流向城里，许多房子也被淹没了。
sentences.traditional: 海水流向城裡，許多房子也被淹沒了。
sentences.pinyin: hǎi shuǐ liú xiàng chéng lǐ xǔ duō fáng zi yě bèi yān mò le
sentences.english: Seawater flowed into the city, and many houses were also flooded.

sentence_translations: 22. The Flooding of Jinshan Temple
Jinshan Temple was not far from Hangzhou. It was a famous, large temple in the area.
There were many monks in the temple.  They were all Fahai’s disciples, but Fahai did not teach them magic. He only wanted to teach Xu Xian.
In Fahai’s heart, Xu Xian was most likely to become an immortal through spiritual practice.
So, he considered Xu Xian his only true disciple.
After Xu Xian got to Jinshan Temple, he never had the chance to leave again.
He lived in the same room as Fahai, and Fahai taught him spiritual practice every day.
However, Xu Xian felt empty inside. He didn’t want to learn anything.
He would think of Bai Suzhen, and then would think of that white snake in the sky.
Bai Suzhen being a snake demon was something he had now accepted—
No matter what she is, I love her. She is the mother of my child, the person I love the most.
A month had passed, and Xu Xian missed Bai Suzhen more and more.
On this day, Fahai was guiding Xu Xian in spiritual practice when a loud noise came from outside the temple.
“Fahai, let my husband go now!”
It was Bai Suzhen’s voice.
Xu Xian was the first to rush out. He saw Bai Suzhen and Xiaoqing flying in the sky. Tears immediately fell from his eyes.
“My husband!” Bai Suzhen also saw him.
Xu Xian ran towards Bai Suzhen, but a golden light from behind him held him back.
This golden light belonged to Fahai. “Audacious snake demon! How dare you come to my Jinshan Temple!” Fahai shouted angrily.
Bai Suzhen looked at Fahai, her eyes flickering with fire: “Fahai, although I am a demon, I have never done anything bad.
You are a monk, yet you are doing things to separate me from my husband.
Who is a good person and who is a bad person, I believe people will know!
Today, if you don’t let my husband go, I will make sure you can never see Jinshan Temple again!”
“What a bold claim!”
Fahai raised his alms bowl high. It emitted a strong light, shining down on Bai Suzhen.
Xiaoqing transformed into a bolt of green lightning and struck towards Fahai.
However, Fahai was protected by a layer of golden light, preventing Xiaoqing’s lightning from penetrating.
Bai Suzhen began to use a spell. The wind rose, and the clouds gathered. The heavens and the earth changed color!
Raindrops fell. In the heavy rain, the heavens and the earth turned into a sheet of black.
Slowly, a sea appeared in the black sky, and seawater was rushing towards Jinshan Temple!
“Sea! A big sea! How can there be a sea in the sky?”
“Quick, run! A flood is coming!”
The monks in Jinshan Temple shouted as they ran.
Fahai turned his alms bowl towards the sky, and the sea was illuminated.
The seawater rushed in extremely quickly. It was fast and furious.
Fahai was both shocked and anxious: “How does this snake demon have such strong magical powers?”
Xu Xian stood behind Fahai. He looked at the seawater in the sky in shock, his face turning pale with fear.
He was frightened, and it took him a while to understand.
He shouted in the direction of Bai Suzhen, “Don’t do this! Quick, take this water back!”
Even though he was speaking in his loudest voice, it was still too quiet.
Bai Suzhen in the sky could not hear anything at all.
“Go!” Fahai grabbed Xu Xian and flew out of Jinshan Temple.
The sky collapsed, and the seawater rushed in. Jinshan Temple was immediately flooded by the seawater.
Seawater flowed into the city, and many houses were also flooded.
